query:
UPDATE coins
        SET spent_height = ?
        WHERE spent_height IS NULL
          AND id IN (
            SELECT mempool_coins.coin_id
            FROM mempool_coins
            INNER JOIN mempool_items ON mempool_items.id = mempool_coins.mempool_item_id
            WHERE mempool_items.hash = ?
              AND mempool_coins.is_input = TRUE
          )
